{"consolidated_memory":"## Route Shadowing Issues in api/gateway/router.go

This location has experienced two distinct route shadowing problems in the router, both manifesting the same signal but with different triggers and fixes:

### Incident 1: [2026-01-23] Transaction Wrapping Issue
- **Component:** api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side)
- **Trigger condition:** Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Signal:** Wrong handler name in the request span
- **Root cause:** Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- **Fix applied:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- **PR:** #3517 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1
- **Reproduction:** Curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- **Measured outcome:** Alert stayed quiet for 22 consecutive days

### Incident 2: [2026-03-15] Unicode Normalization Issue
- **Component:** api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side)
- **Trigger condition:** Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Signal:** Wrong handler name in the request span
- **Root cause:** Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix applied:** Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- **PR:** #5547 on branch fix/route-shadowing-2
- **Reproduction:** Curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- **Measured outcome:** Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 75 days running

**Context note:** Both incidents occurred in the same corner of api/gateway/router.go related to route shadowing, with shared context from earlier route shadowing work."}
